# #241 Undo or apply a deload through the assistant
## Parent
#236
## What to build
A player can tell the assistant to undo an applied Deload, or apply a suggested one, for their next workout only. If fatigue still flags after that workout, the default returns and the banner shows again. A coached player's choice is added as a note on the coach's deload alert (ADR 055).
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The assistant router has a deterministic deload intent (no model) that recognises undo/apply requests in English and Arabic. - [ ] Undo is accepted only when a deload is `applied`; apply is accepted only when one is `suggested`. Otherwise the assistant replies that there is nothing to change. - [ ] When it acts, the reply restates the fatigue signal and says the change lasts for the next workout only. The done frame reports `program_updated`, so the app refreshes the prescription. - [ ] The choice is stored per ledger and overrides the default for the next prescription. It is used up when the next session is committed, inside the commit's ledger transaction, so an idempotent replay of the same commit doesn't use it up twice. - [ ] For a player on an active assignment, the choice is added as a note on the open `deload_recommended` alert episode. No new alert kind is created. - [ ] Like other program-changing actions, it needs a connection (ADR 031). - [ ] Tests: assistant pipeline routing tests (English/Arabic, both directions, nothing-to-change); API tests covering the next-workout-only effect, consumption at commit, idempotent-replay safety and the coach alert note; a widget test that the logger reflects the refreshed prescription.
